races.name: Clearanswer Call Centres Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lovers Leap
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with De Sousa aboard showing improved form last time, but may struggle to control the pace without pressure from behind.

runners_data.name: Crown Of Dreams
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning quickly from Thirsk debut, low rating but ideal tactical setup for late closer under Hart's patient handling.

runners_data.name: Way Of The Will
runners_data.note: Four-year-old hold-up type returning from long break, proven on good going but carrying weight penalty as older horse.

runners_data.name: Longevity
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but long absence of 187 days raises fitness concerns despite Tinkler's 14-day record being modest.

runners_data.name: Talking In Kode
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up horse who has shown consistency on good going, Orr's tactical awareness could prove crucial in slow-run affair.

races.paceDynamic: With Food For Thought withdrawn, this becomes a pace collapse scenario with only prominent runners Lovers Leap and Longevity likely to show early, neither being confirmed front-runners. The lack of natural pace will create a crawling gallop through the early stages before accelerating sharply in the final 3f. Crown Of Dreams, Way Of The Will, and Talking In Kode all possess hold-up styles that thrive when they can unleash late kicks from off the pace. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best work in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lovers Leap and Longevity set a modest early gallop allowing the field to stay bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 3f sprint where natural finishing speed trumps early positioning. Hold-up specialists Crown Of Dreams and Talking In Kode can unleash devastating late kicks when the pace finally quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lovers Leap Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Lovers Leap takes charge early and dictates a more genuine pace under De Sousa
scenarios.body: Her recent third at Sandown suggests improved form and she can kick clear when the field comes under pressure. The sustained tempo prevents the hold-up horses from mounting their preferred late charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Longevity Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the long absence has freshened Longevity and she shows more early pace than expected
scenarios.body: Tinkler's filly could steal a march on better-rated rivals who are caught napping by her improved attitude. Her prominent style works if she can maintain the gallop longer than anticipated.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Experience
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace leads to stop-start fractions and tactical positioning becomes crucial
scenarios.body: Experienced jockeys like Hart and Orr can navigate the tactical minefield better than less seasoned riders. The race becomes about being in the right place when the sprint develops rather than pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Crown Of Dreams and Talking In Kode settling too far back if the pace is even slower than expected, potentially leaving too much ground to make up
Lovers Leap being left in front too early without enough pace pressure, making her vulnerable to late swoops
Way Of The Will's fitness levels after 269-day absence, though the Fahey stable often have them ready first time back
Longevity's ability to maintain her prominent position after such a lengthy layoff may see her fade in the final furlong
The overall pace development in the first half-mile will determine whether this becomes a true test or a sprint finish

races.name: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish "Confined" EBF Novice Stakes (One Run Or Less) (GBB/IRE Inc')

runners_data.name: Anchiano
runners_data.note: Unraced colt from powerful Scott stable with Tudhope booked, unknown pace preference but bred to be sharp over this trip

runners_data.name: Bladey Lady
runners_data.note: Debut runner from prolific Easterby yard, Allan takes the ride suggesting confidence but complete unknown quantity tactically

runners_data.name: Navy Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who ran respectably on debut, proven on similar going conditions and holds clear form advantage over exposed rivals

runners_data.name: Suzie May
runners_data.note: Held-up sort who faded badly on soft debut, needs to overcome finishing concerns and poor trainer strike-rate this fortnight

runners_data.name: Ronson
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who struggled on debut, similar going experience to Navy Light but significantly lower rating suggests limited ability

runners_data.name: Mr Darling
runners_data.note: Faded on soft debut like Suzie May, very recent run could have him spot-on but lowest rating in field suggests quality concerns

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runners in this small field, the early pace will likely be steady rather than fierce. Anchiano and Bladey Lady as the unknowns could dictate terms if they show early pace, but the hold-up brigade of Navy Light, Suzie May, Ronson and Mr Darling suggests a cagey start. The lack of natural pace-setters will create a tactical affair that builds gradually before exploding into a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position handy and kick, as pure hold-up horses may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout with no horse willing to commit early
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up turning for home before a frantic sprint over the final furlong and a half. Navy Light's superior rating and proven form gives him the edge in a driving finish over horses who may not handle the pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomers Show Early Zip
scenarios.trigger: If Anchiano or Bladey Lady break smartly and show natural pace from their powerful connections
scenarios.body: Either newcomer could steal a march on the hold-up horses by getting first run in the straight. Their higher official ratings suggest class that could prove decisive if they handle debut/second start nerves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with everyone waiting and no one willing to commit
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure test of acceleration from the back with the best finisher prevailing. Navy Light's proven ability to quicken makes him hard to beat, while the slower early fractions help the lesser lights stay competitive longer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fade-Prone Types Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Suzie May or Mr Darling get aggressive early tactics from their jockeys to combat their finishing concerns
scenarios.body: By getting prominent early rather than held up, these horses avoid their usual fade pattern. The tactical switch could catch the field cold if they maintain their position into the straight.

watchPoints.text: Navy Light is the only horse with proven form and a superior rating - if he handles the likely sprint finish he's hard to oppose
Watch how Anchiano and Bladey Lady break from the stalls as their early positioning could determine if they're pace-makers or hold-up horses
The jockey tactics on Suzie May and Mr Darling will reveal if connections try aggressive early positioning to combat their fading tendencies
With only six runners, any horse that gets shuffled back or trapped behind horses turning for home faces a difficult task in the sprint finish
The going has firmed up from the original Good, which should suit the higher-class newcomers more than the exposed hold-up horses

races.name: Bowel Cancer Screening Programme Saves Lives Selling Stakes

runners_data.name: Tide Runner
runners_data.note: Unknown running style creates tactical uncertainty but highest official rating of 120 suggests genuine ability if fit after break.

runners_data.name: Merlier
runners_data.note: Natural leader with Hollie Doyle aboard, recent good form on similar going makes her the pace anchor.

runners_data.name: Saucy Jane
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who can track Merlier perfectly, trainer struggling for winners recently but horse shows consistent form.

runners_data.name: Artista
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with cheekpieces fitted, needs pace collapse to be effective from the back in this small field.

runners_data.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners_data.note: Forward-going type who can press early pace, but lowest official rating suggests outclassed at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Merlier will lead from the gates with no other natural front-runners to challenge, setting an uncontested pace over this 5f sprint. Saucy Jane and Jack Rabbit Slims will track prominently behind, while Artista will drop out the back looking for cover. With Merlier able to dictate fractions without pressure, the early leaders can maintain their positions into the straight, making this a race that clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Merlier gets easy fractions and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows her to quicken clear in the final furlong, with prominent racers filling the places. Front-running tactics prove decisive on this sharp 5f track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Saucy Jane or Jack Rabbit Slims can sit perfectly behind Merlier
scenarios.body: They get the ideal stalking trip before challenging the tiring leader in the final 100 yards. The tactical advantage of tracking the pace without making it pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Artista gets a clear run
scenarios.body: She can use her superior class rating to sweep past tired leaders in the closing stages. The hold-up style benefits from a truly-run race with room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tide Runner Wild Card
scenarios.trigger: If the unknown quantity Tide Runner shows unexpected gate speed or finishing kick
scenarios.body: His lightly-raced profile and highest official rating could produce a shock result despite style uncertainty. Class tells when tactical patterns break down.

watchPoints.text: Tide Runner's stable debut for Jason Hart could catch market unaware if showing improved fitness from break.
Merlier getting too easy a lead through early fractions without any pace pressure from prominent racers.
Artista needing clear daylight in straight as hold-up horse in small field where gaps may not appear.
Jack Rabbit Slims attempting to press Merlier early could set up race for closers despite natural front-running advantage.
Going reports showing Good To Firm throughout card may be faster than official Good designation suggests.

runners_data.name: Sherlock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from the powerful Kevin Ryan yard who needs the pace to collapse to be competitive over this minimum trip

runners_data.name: Tanjen
runners_data.note: Natural front runner from Tim Easterby stable who should take them along but form figures suggest vulnerability when pressed

races.paceDynamic: Tanjen and Jojo Rabbit are confirmed front runners who will ensure a genuine gallop from the start in this 5f sprint. With both likely to go forward, the early fractions should be honest rather than crawling, creating a searching test over the minimum trip. The pace will be solid throughout with little respite, meaning horses need to be sharp and ready to go from flag-fall. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in a truly-run sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Tanjen and Jojo Rabbit both break alertly and maintain a genuine clip throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will find out the back markers and set up the race for those racing handy. Prominent racers like Miss Brazen and Fuji Mountain can track the leaders and strike late when the front pair weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Tanjen or Jojo Rabbit gets an uncontested lead while the other misses the break or settles
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march on the field. With less early pace pressure, the leader could kick clear in the final furlong before challengers respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Tanjen and Jojo Rabbit are slow away or settle further back than expected
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker with all runners still in contention turning for home. This transforms into a dash where the best turn of foot wins regardless of early position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fierce Early Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses join the two leaders in a fierce early gallop
scenarios.body: The breakneck early pace will set up a dramatic collapse of the front rank in the final furlong. Hold-up horses get their perfect scenario as the early leaders come back to them dramatically.

watchPoints.text: Watch if either Tanjen or Jojo Rabbit misses the break as this completely changes the pace dynamic and favours closers
Monitor the early fractions closely - if both leaders go off too fast they'll set it up perfectly for prominent trackers like Miss Brazen
Keep an eye on Glory Hyde's position turning for home as he needs to be closer than usual over this shorter 5f trip
Watch for Fuji Mountain to be produced with a late run as his recent form suggests he's progressive and well-handicapped
If the pace is only modest early, be wary of backing hold-up horses as they'll struggle to make up ground in the straight

races.paceDynamic: Not Me leads with Donna Nook and Hopeful Joy pressing, creating a steady but uncontested gallop over this extended trip. The large field of hold-up horses including Amidst The Chaos, Dr Rio, Coolree and Sunny Orange will bunch up mid-pack, with only Betty Bassett offering additional pace support. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the early leaders can dictate fractions and kick clear when they choose. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can track the pace, rather than the mass of hold-up horses who will need the leaders to fold.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Sustain
scenarios.trigger: If Not Me and Donna Nook maintain their positions without excessive early pace
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows them to control the race and use their class advantage, with the hold-up brigade struggling to make up ground on good ground. Prominent runners can track and strike when ready.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady and the field bunches approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The class horses from the back get their chance as the race opens up, with Amidst The Chaos and Coolree having the form to capitalise. The good ground aids their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Hopeful Joy or Betty Bassett decide to apply early pressure to the leaders
scenarios.body: This creates a faster pace that could set up the race for the hold-up horses, particularly those with proven stamina like Tees George. The complexion changes with sustained pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: Long-absent runners like Hopeful Joy could benefit from the tactical scenario, while improvers like Superfortress get their conditions. Fitness becomes less relevant in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Not Me and Donna Nook could steal this if they get an uncontested lead and maintain their gallop to the line
Watch for any early pace pressure from Hopeful Joy or Betty Bassett as it would completely change the race dynamics
Amidst The Chaos and Coolree need the race to develop into a true test to showcase their finishing kicks
The good ground conditions favour Dr Rio and Sunny Orange who have excellent records on similar surfaces
Several hold-up horses may find themselves too far back if the pace stays steady throughout

races.paceDynamic: Regal Knight is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the bell without pressure, likely creating a sustainable tempo through the early stages at Beverley's 1m2f. With Attention Seeker the only prominent runner, the pace will be moderate rather than strong, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to stay in touch without being stretched. The combination of an uncontested leader and patient tactics from the bulk of the field means this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as they'll get the slower tempo they need to be effective over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Regal Knight gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm without pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop suits his stamina reserves and he can dictate when to quicken. Hold-up horses get drawn into a sprint finish they may not handle as effectively as the race-fit leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and multiple hold-up horses unleash finishing drives
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as fresher legs overhaul the front-runner in the final furlong. Class and recent form separate the closers in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Attention Seeker Stalks
scenarios.trigger: If Attention Seeker moves closer to pressure Regal Knight approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: This creates a genuine tempo lift that suits horses with tactical speed over pure stamina. The increased gallop brings prominent runners into play while potentially stretching pure stayers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a tactical affair
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a messy, stop-start rhythm that favours nothing in particular. Form and class become less relevant as track position and racing luck dominate the outcome.
